title: Open Filmmaker Toolkit project file, version 1
description: The shared, local-first project file used by Open Filmmaker Toolkit tools. Unknown properties are allowed so tools can preserve fields owned by other tools.

subjects.description: People you might film, kept by the subject tracker until they're added to people.

sources.description: Research sources and archival leads, kept by the research and archival log.

comps.description: Comparable films for pitches and sales, kept by the comps tracker.

grants.description: Grants and funds applied to or considered, kept by the grant calendar.

narratives.description: Reusable grant application answers in versions by length, kept by the grant narrative library.

budget.description: The production budget, kept by the budget tool. A record rather than a collection.

budgetLinks.description: For each tool that sends its costs to the budget (gear-list, travel-sheet, coi-permit-tracker), the account its lines go in.

budgetFormats.description: Funder budget formats and how the budget maps to them, kept by the budget converter.

budgetTotal.description: Used when the project has no budget.

financePlan.description: Where the money comes from, kept by the finance plan. A record rather than a collection.

funders.description: Funders, investors, broadcasters and other organizations, with contacts, a log and next steps, kept by the funder CRM.

accounts.description: Budget account id to when it's paid.

lines.description: Budget line id to when it's paid, overriding its account.

markups.description: Budget percentage id to when it's paid.

cashFlow.description: When the budget's costs are paid, kept by the cash flow tool. A record rather than a collection.

shootDays.description: Shoot days, travel days and holds, kept by the shooting calendar.

script.description: The screenplay the scenes come from, in Fountain, kept by the script breakdown. A record rather than a collection.

scenes.description: The script's scenes with their cast, elements and location, kept by the script breakdown.

characters.description: The characters in the script, numbered for the schedule, and who plays each one, kept by the script breakdown.

shots.description: Shots for each scene, with a frame for the storyboard, kept by the shot list.

hidden.description: Built-in scout items the crew doesn't use.

scoutChecklist.description: The project's scout checklist, kept by the location scout sheet.

questionBank.description: Questions to reuse across interviews, kept by interview prep.

releaseForms.description: The production's own wording for blank release forms and crowd notices, kept by the release tracker.

stringOuts.description: String-outs of interview moments in order, kept by the interview log.

dropDays.description: A gap between work days longer than this drops someone until they're needed again; 0 never drops.

dayOutOfDays.description: Settings for the day-out-of-days. A record rather than a collection.

interviews.description: Interview plans with research, story beats and questions, kept by interview prep.

journal.description: Dated journal entries tagged with people and locations and linked to call sheets, kept by the field journal.

scouts.description: Location scouts, kept by the location scout sheet.

gear.description: Gear by department and the packages for each shoot day, kept by the gear list. A record rather than a collection.

trips.description: Trips with travel, places to stay, local contacts and emergency details, kept by the travel sheet.

riskPlans.description: Risk assessments and emergency plans, kept by the risk and hostile-environment plans tool.

security.description: The security checklist: who is on it and what each person has done. A record rather than a collection.

mediaReports.description: Camera and sound reports, one for each card or roll, kept by camera and sound reports.

dailyReports.description: Daily production reports, one for each shoot day, kept by the daily production report; they refer to shootDays, callSheets, people and mediaReports.

expenses.description: Expenses, per diems and petty cash, kept by the expense log; they refer to budget accounts, shootDays, people and a receipt asset.

festivals.description: Festival submissions with deadlines, fees, status and screening dates, kept by the festival submission tracker.

screenings.description: Screenings and events, shared by the press list and the partner CRM, which add and link them; they can name a location.

pressOutlets.description: Press outlets with contacts by beat, screeners sent, screening RSVPs and coverage, kept by the press list.

partners.description: Outreach partners with contacts, commitments and the screenings they are part of, kept by the partner CRM.

discussionGuide.description: Screening-specific synopsis, themes, questions and resources, kept by the discussion guide builder.

paperEdit.description: Transcripts and the scenes of bites picked from them, kept by the paper edit. A record rather than a collection.

costReport.description: Estimates to complete and the report date, kept by budget-to-actuals. A record rather than a collection.

structure.description: Acts, sequences, scene cards and story threads, kept by the structure board. A record rather than a collection.

cuts.description: Cuts with their screenings and notes, kept by the cut version tracker.

clearanceReport.description: Scripts and transcripts with marked references, kept by the annotated-transcript clearance report. A record rather than a collection.

chainOfTitle.description: Links, statuses and your own items for the chain-of-title binder. A record rather than a collection.

festivalStrategy.description: Where the film is from, for the festival strategy map.

pressNotes.description: Press notes and EPK sections, kept by the EPK and press notes builder.

bioIds.description: People whose bios are in the press notes, in order.

stillIds.description: Stills in the press notes, in order: assets with an image in data. The first is used on the title page.

specs.description: Technical details: year, country, language, subtitles, format, aspectRatio, sound.

hidden.description: Sections left out of the press notes, by key.

awards.description: Awards campaigns, kept by the awards and social calendars.

rules.description: Eligibility rules, as the award states them.

socialPosts.description: Planned social posts, kept by the awards and social calendars.

eventKey.description: The festival or release moment a suggested post was made for, such as festival:<id>:week.

deliverables.description: The deliverables checklist: who it is for, when it is due, and the items you have changed or added.

key.description: A built-in item, such as dcp or cue, or the id of your own item.

qc.description: Master versions and QC reports with their issues, kept by the QC tracker.

fixedInId.description: The master version it was fixed in.

cutId.description: The cut it was found in, in cuts.

waterfall.description: The recoupment waterfall: tiers in the order they are paid, and revenue scenarios, kept by the recoupment waterfall model.

kind.description: gross: a percentage of gross receipts off the top. percent: a percentage of what is left. fixed: an amount paid until it is paid in full. split: what is left, split between parties.

revenueStatements.description: Statements from distributors, sales agents and platforms, kept by the revenue tracker.

contractId.description: The distribution deal in contracts, if there is one.

net.description: Due to the producer. When unset, gross less fees and expenses.

bookings.description: Educational licenses and theatrical and community bookings, kept by the booking trackers.

materials.description: The date each material was sent, by key.

theoryOfChange.description: How the campaign leads to change, kept by the theory of change builder.

screeningKit.description: The screening kit for hosts, kept by the screening kit builder.

imageIds.description: Approved stills and key art in assets, for hosts to use.

removed.description: Built-in checklist items taken out, by key.

impactReport.description: The impact report, kept by the impact report tool.

results.description: Results by indicator id in theoryOfChange.

finalCostReport.description: The final cost report, kept by the final cost report tool: the date costs run to, whether it is final, and variance notes.

notes.description: Variance notes by account id, markup:<id>, a funder category id, or a section id.

grantReports.description: Final reports for awarded grants, kept by the grant final reports tool.

deliverables.description: What was promised, one per line.

budgetFormatId.description: A budget format id, or "account" or "top". When unset, the format for this grant, or the top sheet.

contractArchive.description: The contract and release archive: where it is kept, when it was checked, and notes by contract id.

openBy.description: Who has the file open. Tools ignore entries older than four hours.

exchangeRates.description: Exchange rates typed in by the user: what one unit of a currency is worth in the project currency. A rate with a date applies from that date; one without a date applies otherwise.

onCamera.description: True if this person appears or is heard on camera and needs a release. False excludes them even if a release names them.

bio.description: A short biography, for press notes and pitch materials.

onCamera.description: True if this place is filmed and needs a location release. False excludes it even if a call sheet uses it.

fairUse.description: Fair use log: the reasoning for an element marked fair use.

uses.description: Where the element is in the edit, from an edit list.

clipNames.description: Source clip names in edit lists that are this element.

personIds.description: People seen or heard in the element.

requiredCredit.description: Exact wording of an on-screen credit this agreement requires.

role.description: Deal memos: the crew member's role.

guarantee.description: Deal memos: guaranteed days or weeks.

writtenFor.description: Where the form was written for, such as a state and country.

budgetLineIds.description: Deal memos: the budget lines this memo keeps up to date, rate first, then kit fee.

vendor.description: Certificates of insurance: the vendor or location the certificate is for.

insurer.description: Certificates of insurance: the insurer or broker.

namedOn.description: Certificates of insurance: who is named on it, such as the certificate holder and additional insured.

requestedDate.description: Certificates: requested on. Permits: applied for on.

receivedDate.description: Certificates: received on. Permits: issued on.

shootDayIds.description: Certificates and permits: the shoot days in shootDays they cover.

term.description: Licenses: how long, such as "In perpetuity".

options.description: Licenses: options and step deals to exercise later.

licensee.description: Distribution deals: the distributor, broadcaster or platform.

exclusive.description: Distribution deals: false for a non-exclusive deal. Exclusive when unset.

currency.description: The amount's currency, when it isn't the project currency. Totals convert it at the project's exchange rates.

rates.description: A deal memo's other rates, such as prep or travel days, each with its own budget line.

data.description: The image itself as a data URL, for photos kept in the project file, such as scout photos.

archiveCopies.description: Copies of this project asset held in long-term storage, including their locations, hash manifests and manual read-back checks.

description.description: Footage log clips: what's in it.

date.description: Footage log clips: when it was shot.

personIds.description: Who is in it: people in a footage log clip or pictured in a still.

locationIds.description: Footage log clips: where it was shot.

rating.description: Footage log clips: rating from 1 to 5.

timecode.description: Footage log clips: the starting timecode.

card.description: Footage log clips: the card or roll.

mediaReportId.description: Footage log clips: the camera report it came from, in mediaReports.

clipId.description: Footage log clips: the clip in that report.

photoCredit.description: Stills: who took the photo, for the credit line.

approval.description: Stills library: whether the still is approved for publicity.

hashList.description: Hash manifest text or a reference to a manifest produced by another tool.

discussionGuide.description: A screening discussion guide, kept by the discussion guide builder.

themes.description: Themes to explore, one per line.

resourceNotes.description: Audience-facing resources or links, one per line.

partnerIds.description: Selected outreach partners to include in the guide.

credits.description: The film's credits, in order, as built by the credits builder.

notCredited.description: People who are deliberately left out of the credits.

kind.description: credit: a line with names under it. heading: a section heading. text: lines shown as typed. music and archival: blocks built from the third-party elements.

role.description: For a credit, the line above the names.

names.description: Names that aren't people in the project, shown after personIds.

text.description: For a heading or text entry.

heading.description: For a music or archival block.

excluded.description: For a music or archival block, the songs or sources left out, as lowercase keys of their title or name.

supers.description: On-screen names and titles (supers and lower thirds), as kept by the name supers list.

lastExport.description: What the list looked like when it was last exported for graphics, so changes since then can be flagged.

personId.description: A person in people. Their name is used, so the spelling matches the rest of the project.

name.description: The name on screen, for someone who isn't in people.

title.description: The second line of the super.

firstAppears.description: Timecode in the cut where the super first appears, as HH:MM:SS:FF.

about.description: Who they are, in a line.

personId.description: The person in people this subject became.

status.description: Archival leads: found, screener-requested, screener-received, ready-to-license or not-using. Research sources: to-check, checked, using or not-using.

type.description: A clearance log type, such as Archival footage.

archive.description: Archive or collection; for research sources, the author or publisher.

link.description: A catalog link or call number, kept as text.

elementId.description: The third-party element this source became in the clearance log.

cardId.description: The card on the structure board where it's used.

why.description: Why it's comparable, for the pitch.

treatment.description: The film's treatment, written in the treatment builder.

sections.description: Text for each part of the treatment: logline, shortSynopsis, longSynopsis, subjects, structure, approach, access, whyNow, team.

targets.description: Word targets that differ from the tool's defaults, by section.

pitchDeck.description: A pitch deck or lookbook, built in the pitch deck builder.

kind.description: team and comps slides are built from people and comps each time.

data.description: The image, resized, as a data URL, so it opens in any browser without leaving the project file.

deadlineTime.description: Time and time zone of the deadline, as text, such as "5 pm Eastern".

amount.description: What the funder offers, as text, such as "Up to $50,000".

requested.description: Amount asked for, in the project's currency.

awarded.description: Amount awarded, in the project's currency.

materials.description: What the application needs, ticked off when ready.

title.description: What the answer is, such as Logline.

label.description: A name for the version, when the length isn't enough.

use.description: What it was used for when it isn't the application, such as "final report".

uses.description: Who this version was sent to, and when: a grant in grants, or a funder by name.

multiplier.description: Such as the number of people. Defaults to 1.

currency.description: The amount's currency, when it isn't the project currency. Totals convert it at the project's exchange rates.

fringeIds.description: Every fringe on the line, when it has more than one. fringeId stays the first, for older tools.

tool.description: The tool that keeps the line up to date, such as gear-list.

source.description: Where the line comes from, when another tool keeps its numbers up to date.

cap.description: For a fringe: it applies only to wages up to this amount for each person on a line.

fringes.description: Percentages of the lines they're applied to.

markups.description: Percentages of all lines plus fringes, such as contingency and insurance.

fringes.description: Percentages of the lines they're applied to.

markups.description: Percentages of all lines plus fringes, such as contingency and insurance.

versions.description: Saved copies of the budget to compare against.

accountMap.description: Account id to category id; an empty string means left out.

lineMap.description: Line id to category id, overriding its account.

fringeTo.description: "line" to keep fringes with their lines, a category id, or an empty string to leave them out.

grantId.description: A grant in grants; the source then follows its status and amount.

currency.description: The amount's currency, when it isn't the project currency. Totals convert it at the project's exchange rates.

completedSceneIds.description: Scenes finished that day, in scenes.

budgetLineId.description: Budget-to-actuals: the line in the expense's account it counts against, in budget.lines.

currency.description: The amount's currency, when it isn't the project currency. Totals convert it at the project's exchange rates.

tier.description: Festival strategy map: 1 for the top festivals down to 4 for local or small ones.

premiere.description: Festival strategy map: the premiere status the festival asks for.

region.description: Festival strategy map: the world region, such as North America or Europe.

notifyDate.description: Festival strategy map: when the festival tells you whether you got in.

attendance.description: How many people came, recorded in the impact report.

block.description: The trip or block the day belongs to.

callSheetId.description: The call sheet started from this day, in callSheets.

sceneIds.description: The scenes scheduled for the day, in shooting order, set on the stripboard.

name.description: For someone not in people yet.

locationId.description: Interview log: where it was filmed, when not the shoot day's location.

mediaReportIds.description: Interview log: the camera and sound reports for the cards it's on.

cards.description: Interview log: other cards or files, separated by commas.

transcriptAssetId.description: Interview log: the transcript, an asset with type "transcript".

beatId.description: A beat in this interview's beats.

kind.description: What happened, what was learned, or a story idea.

callSheetId.description: The shoot day: a call sheet in callSheets.

from.description: The owner, who lent it, or the rental house.

value.description: Replacement value of one unit, for the insurance schedule.

block.description: The trip in the shooting calendar: the block shared by its shootDays.

personIds.description: Who this is for; everyone on the trip when unset.
Who stays here; everyone on the trip when unset.

perDiem.description: A day's per diem for each person on the trip.

controls.description: What you will do about it.

escalation.description: What to do when someone misses a check-in, in order.

hidden.description: Built-in items set aside as not for this production.

done.description: Item id to the people who have done it.

callSheetId.description: The call sheet for that day, in callSheets.

roll.description: The card or roll name, such as A001.

lens.description: The lens for camera clips, the tracks for sound files.

scene.description: The scene number on the slate.

shot.description: The setup or shot on the slate, such as 12A.

scriptNotes.description: The script supervisor's notes on the take.

assetId.description: The card itself, an asset with type "camera card" or "sound card" and a relativePath.

personId.description: Speaker when a line names none, in people.

clipId.description: The clip in the footage log, in assets.

clipName.description: The clip name editing apps match the media by.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the clip.

in.description: Seconds from the start of the clip.

tcIn.description: Source in, kept so the bite keeps its timecode if its transcript is removed.

momentId.description: The moment in the interview log it came from.

asOf.description: Counts expenses up to this date.

lineId.description: The budget line it's committed against.

purchaseOrders.description: Purchase orders, committed against budget lines.

actId.description: An act, for a card outside a sequence.

cards.description: In order. A card with neither an actId nor a sequenceId is not on the board yet.

locked.description: The locked cut; only one. Locking it sets project.cutVersion and project.runningTime.

exportFile.description: Where the export is, relative to the project file, or its name on a review site.

startTc.description: The timecode at time zero, HH:MM:SS:FF.

key.description: A built-in item such as "cr-film", or "contract:", "person:" or "element:" and an id for one from the project.

fileName.description: The file the script was imported from.

pages.description: About how many pages the script runs.

number.description: The scene number, such as 12 or 12A.

heading.description: The scene heading, such as EXT. RIVERSIDE LEVEE - NIGHT.

time.description: Time of day, such as DAY or NIGHT.

eighths.description: Length in eighths of a page.

page.description: The script page the scene starts on.

characterIds.description: Characters in the scene, in characters.

notInScript.description: The scene isn't in the script imported last.

number.description: The cast number used on the schedule and call sheets.

personId.description: Who plays the part, in people.

group.description: A group for shots with no scene, such as b-roll.

frame.description: A picture for the storyboard, as a data URL.
